title: Furniture families, platforms and decor (paintings, banners, chandeliers, lanterns, bookcases, clocks, statues, editable signs)
player_outcome: Building feels like Terraria: every wood/material has a full furniture family (door, chair, table, bed, chest, workbench, bookcase, piano, sofa, bathtub, lamp, lantern, candelabra, chandelier, clock, platform), paintings and banners decorate walls (enemy banners from kills give a damage bonus near them, like Terraria), statues, and editable signs show text.
design: Data: per-material furniture families generated from one table (tools/content generator like gen_ore_tiers) into data/tileobjects + recipes (Wood, Boreal, Palm, Rich Mahogany, Ebonwood, Shadewood, Pearlwood, Granite, Marble, Glass, Bone, Living Wood, Dynasty, Lihzahrd, Obsidian…); platform items per material.
Reuse the bosses session's dungeon furniture helpers (P4-17/18) — merge origin/claude/ovh-bosses after its W8 push before starting; do not duplicate banners/statues/bookcases, extend them.
Blender: parametric furniture generators in tools/blender (bevelled, material-textured; respect P4-38 bevel work), icons.
Enemy banners: a banner drops every 50 kills (player journal/kill counter), placed banners give +damage/-damage-taken vs that enemy nearby (data-driven buff).
Signs: tile object with editable text stored in object meta (P2-08 object-meta section), shown on hover and in a small edit dialog (theme from P2-01).
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: builder.cmds places a full family; validate passes
